summary: This bill extends the authorization for federal grants for intercity passenger rail projects through fiscal year 2032.

scores.thoughts: This bill extends the authorization for appropriations for intercity passenger rail grants through fiscal year 2032. While it doesn't directly appropriate funds, extending the authorization makes future government spending on these grants possible and likely, thus increasing potential spending.

The bill's sole purpose is extending federal grant authorizations for intercity passenger rail through FY 2032, committing additional spending without offsets or cuts elsewhere; this directly supports larger deficits to fund transportation priorities and constitutes the entire content of the legislation.
